imu._delta_temp_c: ASSUMPTION: IMU temperature change after the pre-flight bias calibration; residual bias = datasheet tempco x this, for parts that publish no in-run bias stability
imu._source: Bosch BST-BMI088-DS000-19 Rev 1.9 (Jan 2024), Table 4 p.9 (accel ND 160 ug/rtHz X/Y @+-3g, zero-g 20 mg, offset drift <0.2 mg/K) and Table 5 p.10 (gyro 0.014 dps/rtHz, ZRO +-1 dps, +-0.015 dps/K). No bias instability published. https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/media/boschsensortec/downloads/datasheets/bst-bmi088-ds001.pdf
imu._price: DigiKey FR EUR 4.52 qty 1 cut tape (~$4.90), 2026-10; Mouser ~$4.58-5.23 via aggregators: https://www.digikey.fr/en/products/detail/bosch-sensortec/BMI088/8634942

mag._source: PNI RM3100 manual 1017252 R07, Table 3-1 p.6: 15 nT @ 200 cycle counts (max ~147 Hz 3-axis). Mirror: https://xcopter.com/download/RM3100-Sensor.pdf
mag._residual_hard_iron_ut: ASSUMPTION, not a datasheet number: per-axis 1-sigma hard-iron residual after in-field calibration, ~1.2 deg heading sigma in a ~19 uT horizontal field; matches Wu, Wang & Liang 2011 (heading sigma < 1.2 deg after UAV in-field calibration) https://hkxb.buaa.edu.cn/EN/abstract/article/1000-6893/12683
mag._price: LCSC RM3100 bare sensor set, qty 1, 2026-10: https://lcsc.com/product-detail/Magnetic-Sensors_PNI-C464558_C464558.html
